description: This is an Android activity class named MainActivity for a MIDI synthesizer app. It sets up MIDI connections, manages UI menu options, and handles lifecycle events related to MIDI resources.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Activity class managing MIDI setup and user interface for a simple MIDI synthesizer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI and MIDI if supported.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and sets screen keep flag.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling keep screen on.

methods.name: setKeepScreenOn
methods.description: Enables or disables the keep-screen-on flag.

methods.name: setupMidi
methods.description: Initializes MIDI manager and selects MIDI device.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when activity is destroyed.
